events.title: New Cafe View, macOS Support & QoL Improvements
events.summary: Hey everyone! A fresh update just landed for Internet Cafe 98. Here's what's new: New Cafe View The cafe has a brand-new look. The room got a visual refresh, so watching your cafe grow from a few beige boxes into a packed LAN den feels better than ever. macOS Support Internet Cafe 98 now runs on macOS! events.title: A Smoother Start, Thanks to Your Feedback
events.summary: We’ve been going through your feedback, and one thing came up again and again: the beginning of the game could be confusing.The tutorial didn’t explain enough, some steps moved too quickly, and it wasn’t always clear what you were supposed to do next.
